btn-zoom-out.note: ledger row: statusbar.btn-zoom-down — applyZoom sets #editor style zoom 1 -> 0.9 and persists wo-zoom; no post because the runner clicks post BEFORE asserting (a reset post would zero the assertion). The next contract (btn-zoom-in, manifest order 238 > 237) continues from the persisted 0.9

btn-zoom-in.note: ledger row: statusbar.btn-zoom-up — runs after btn-zoom-out in manifest order, so zoom starts at the persisted 0.9; 0.9 + 0.1 lands exactly on 1 (IEEE754), proving the click handler ran (a broken handler would stay at 0.9) and ending with the clean default zoom for later contracts
